# Debug m2 - check what render_inner_html returns
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', '''
import markdown
from markdown.extensions.toc import render_inner_html, run_postprocessors, striptags
import xml.etree.ElementTree as etree

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "footnotes"])
md_text = """# Header with footnote[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: This is the footnote text.
"""

# Parse to get the tree
md.convert(md_text)

# Find the h1 element
for el in md.parser.root.iter():
    if el.tag == 'h1':
        print("=== h1 element ===")
        print(f"tag: {el.tag}")
        print(f"text: {repr(el.text)}")
        print(f"tail: {repr(el.tail)}")
        for i, child in enumerate(el):
            print(f"  child {i}: tag={child.tag}, text={repr(child.text)}, tail={repr(child.tail)}")
        
        inner = render_inner_html(md, el)
        print(f"\\n=== render_inner_html result ===")
        print(repr(inner))
        
        processed = run_postprocessors(md, inner)
        print(f"\\n=== after run_postprocessors ===")
        print(repr(processed))
        
        stripped = striptags(processed)
        print(f"\\n=== after striptags ===")
        print(repr(stripped))
        break
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
